summary.countingNote: 568 overlapping review bundles: 31 lessons, 68 question records, 449 glossary entries and 20 formula cards. These are not an atomic-fact count. Corrections are recorded edit groups/locations, not unique erroneous claims.

corrections: Corrected quiz references that opened unrelated language pages, including HotSpot, spreadsheets, Bash scope, Datalog, JavaScript arrays and Haskell evaluation.
Moved the Kubernetes manifest-recognition question into desired-state teaching, preserving all question identities and answer contracts.
Corrected Java sealed declarations to restrict direct branches rather than all descendants; non-sealed branches may grow.
Corrected GHC rewrite-rule/fusion claims: the compiler trusts rules and transformations must preserve termination/evaluation semantics even for pure code.
Qualified Datalog termination to fair positive finite-domain bottom-up set evaluation; recursive CTEs and unrestricted dialects need their own stopping conditions.
Corrected historical release/development distinctions for Elixir, F# and Erlang; removed the subjective friendlier-syntax claim and unsupported precise Curry biographical dates.
Separated Go class-inheritance absence from interface embedding, inherited implementation from behavioral substitutability, and SCADE/Lustre clocked semantics from fixed-rate actor dataflow.
Fixed a closing formula fence that shared its line with prose, and qualified closure retention/GC/frame allocation and parallelism implementation assumptions.
para-curried-composition.md: Closing fences must stand alone; otherwise the formula consumes following prose.
para-curried-composition.md: Keep verification implementation notes out of the lesson; platform limits are already taught in recursion and runtime units.
para-composition-contracts.md: Go supports embedded interfaces; the relevant absence is class inheritance.
para-nonstrict-arguments.md: Reachability does not require retaining every lexically surrounding value.
para-prolog-search.md: SLD does not itself imply depth-first search.
para-reactive-dataflow.md: Build invalidation includes more than changed file prerequisites.
questions: Moved the declarative Kubernetes-manifest recognition question to the unit that first teaches Kubernetes desired state; both units retain three questions.

lowConfidence.reason: Prioritised primary project announcements, designer histories and institutional pages; corrected Elixir/F#/Kotlin/Erlang date distinctions. Some biographical minutiae and broad influence language have only institutional/authoritative overview corroboration, not original archival evidence. All flagged entries have medium confidence.

lowConfidence.claim: Infrastructure reconciliation and serial ORM latency examples
lowConfidence.reason: Primary Kubernetes/Terraform/Django docs checked and real Django/SQLite 501-versus-1 queries executed. No live cloud deployment or network-latency measurements; stable-input assumptions and hypothetical timings stated.

gaps: Advanced monads, persistent-structure implementation, type theory and compiler internals remain in their later course modules as in the original scope.

Original depth and all 64 executable statement sequences preserved; examples remain educational fixtures rather than production banking/concurrency/deployment implementations.
